name: Member Services Platform
purpose: Enable digital service delivery for members and internal support teams with consistent case management, policy workflows, and integration points.

business.outcomes: Faster member service, fewer manual handoffs, transparent policy handling.
business.stakeholders: Members, case handlers, product owners, platform engineering, security.
business.constraints: Must support existing enterprise identity and compliance controls.

data.domainModel: Member, case, entitlement, document, workflow, and audit records.
data.dataOwners: Member Operations, Data Governance, Product Management.
data.dataClasses: Personal data, operational data, policy data, audit data.

applications.name: Case Management API
applications.responsibility: Handles member case intake, tasks, and workflow orchestration.

applications.name: Policy Decision Service
applications.responsibility: Evaluates rules and applies eligibility logic to decisions.

applications.name: Document Service
applications.responsibility: Stores and retrieves supporting documents and evidence.

technology.platform: Containerized cloud services with event-driven integration
technology.deploymentModel: Multi-service deployment with private networking and API gateways
technology.securityModel: Role-based access, encryption at rest and in transit, audit trails

decisions.decision: Adopt a domain-aligned modular service boundary
decisions.rationale: Keeps domain ownership clear and reduces cross-team coupling.

decisions.decision: Use event-driven integration for asynchronous workflow updates
decisions.rationale: Improves resilience and supports independent service evolution.
